title: Community Technology School
body:
The Community Tech School of Future Inventions is a reading group focused on critical discourse around technology practice from an Afrocentric point of view.

We operate in months-long cycles. Cycle 1 ran from November 2024 to April 2025 and explored topics such as digital colonialism and ancestral technologies. Cycle 2 was themed The Machine and Me, a series of educational events dedicated to demystifying AI through an artistic lens and offering critical perspectives on this rapidly growing yet largely unchecked technology. It ran from Autumn 2025 to Spring 2026.

The CTS hosts sessions between Abuja and London, and online.

The format is an open reading group facilitated by the Future Inventions team in collaboration with guest speakers/facilitators on occasion.
